content:
Maya (Growth): Quick sync: launching a mini social push for next Thursday's webinar. Campaign codename: Pulsewave. Plan = 2 X threads (tease + demo peek), 1 LinkedIn carousel, and targeted DM seeds to warm accounts. KPI: 250 registrants, 30 enterprise leads.

Leo (Content): I'll draft three X openers and a LinkedIn 4-slide carousel. Tone: engineer-first, low-claim. Need hero PNG (1200x628) and a simplified latency chart gif (5s). Can do copy if assets land by 5pm.

Priya (Demand): I'll export the warm list (top 900 contacts last 90d engagement). We'll flag contacts as "pulsewave_warm" and generate seeded shortlinks per variant. Suggest subject line A/B: "Webinar: predictable LLM inference" vs "How teams cut inference spend".

Sam (Ops): Proposed calendar (UTC): X tease: 2026-04-09T16:30:00Z, X demo peek: 2026-04-10T17:00:00Z, LinkedIn carousel: 2026-04-10T17:10:00Z. Seed DMs 45m post-post to top 50 accounts. I'll create CSV import for the scheduler.

Maya (Growth): DMs only to accounts with engagement score >70 and enterprise flag. Form for registration = email only, minimal friction. Priya, please add UTM params: utm_campaign=pulsewave&utm_source=x&utm_medium=social&utm_content={variant}.

Leo (Content): Draft copy ideas:
- "How we balance latency, cost, and quality in production inference. Live demo + real benchmarks."
- "See config choices that preserved output quality while lowering unit cost. Join our demo."

Also propose a 1-line hook for threads: "Ship LLM features with predictable latency — join us."

Priya (Demand): Short links generated: https://rwd.ai/pulsewaveA and https://rwd.ai/pulsewaveB. I'll queue the seeded emails to drop 10m after the first X post. SDRs - can you handle outreach if we get 300 signups? @SDR Team

SDR Team: We can accept ~220 immediate tasks. If >220, we will prioritize enterprise + top intent in the tracker. Set auto-assign to senior reps for enterprise.

Sam (Ops): CSV for scheduler (will import to Buffer):
"platform,iso_time,variant,asset,link,utm"
"X,2026-04-09T16:30:00Z,teaseA,hero_v3.png,https://rwd.ai/pulsewaveA,utm_campaign=pulsewave&utm_content=teaseA"
"X,2026-04-10T17:00:00Z,peekB,hero_v3_alt.png,https://rwd.ai/pulsewaveB,utm_campaign=pulsewave&utm_content=peekB"
"LinkedIn,2026-04-10T17:10:00Z,carousel1,carousel_final.zip,https://rwd.ai/pulsewave,utm_campaign=pulsewave&utm_source=linkedin"

Sam (Ops): I'll also set an alert to push replies containing the shortlink or the words "register"/"sign up" into the tracking sheet and tag SDRs. 15m DM buffer to batch.

Leo (Content): Upload location: https://drive.redwood/marketing/pulsewave-drafts. I'll check for hero + gif and attach alt-text for accessibility.

Maya (Growth): Final EOD checklist: Leo upload assets, Priya seed links + email queue, Sam import schedule + alerts, SDR Team confirm prioritization doc. Quick standup tomorrow 09:30 PT for pre-launch final.

MarketingBot: Drafts saved. Approval workflow set for 17:00 PT. Tracking tags applied: campaign=pulsewave, channel=social.

Priya (Demand): Warm list export done. Shortlinks live.

Leo (Content): Assets uploaded in 40m.

SDR Team: Prioritization doc shared: https://docs.redwood/sdr/pulsewave-priority.

Maya (Growth): Thanks team — ping this thread with any blockers. :sparkles:
